tasks.label: Logger verify repaired label red stage
tasks.command:
Import-Module 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/prophets-pipelines/conventions/scripts/AgentEvidence.psm1' -PassThru | ForEach-Object {
    $runDirectory = 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/.agent-runs/20260913-2133-logger-docs-first-tdd'
    $specification = Get-Content -LiteralPath "$runDirectory/evidence/label-specifications-r2.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 30
    $specificationComparison = Compare-AgentManifest -Baseline $specification
    Save-AgentEvidence -Value $specificationComparison -RunDirectory $runDirectory -Name 'label-parent-specifications-r2.json'
    if (-not $specificationComparison.Matches) { throw 'Protected specification inputs changed.' }
    $configuration = [ordered]@{
        Framework = 'net48'
        BuildConfiguration = 'Debug'
        Restore = $false
        Filter = 'FullyQualifiedName~ProphetsWay.Logger.Test.SensitivityLabelTests'
        ExpectedResult = 'Executed missing-export red with identical repaired-case membership'
        SpecificationBaseline = "$runDirectory/evidence/label-specifications-r2.json"
        VerificationRole = 'Parent independent verification'
    }
    $arguments = @('test', 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/ProphetsWay.Logger/ProphetsWay.Logger.Test/ProphetsWay.Logger.Test.csproj', '--no-restore', '--framework', 'net48', '--configuration', 'Debug', '--filter', 'FullyQualifiedName~ProphetsWay.Logger.Test.SensitivityLabelTests', '--logger', 'trx;LogFileName=label-parent-red-r2.trx', '--results-directory', "$runDirectory/evidence")
    $validation = Invoke-AgentValidation -FilePath dotnet -ArgumentList $arguments -WorkingDirectory 'c:/Projects/ProphetManX/ProphetsWay.Logger' -Configuration $configuration -InputManifestPath "$runDirectory/evidence/label-red-inputs-r2.json" -RunDirectory $runDirectory -Name 'label-parent-red-r2' -Kind Tests -TrxPath "$runDirectory/evidence/label-parent-red-r2.trx"
    $previous = Get-Content -LiteralPath "$runDirectory/evidence/label-red-r2.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 30
    $testComparison = Compare-AgentTestResults -Before $previous -After $validation.Record
    $sameCases = @($testComparison.Differences).Count -eq 0
    $expectedRed = $validation.Record.ExitCode -eq 1 -and -not $validation.Record.TimedOut -and $null -eq $validation.Record.ResultError -and $validation.Record.InputComparison.Matches -and $validation.Record.Results.Counts.Executed -gt 0 -and $validation.Record.Results.Counts.Failed -eq $validation.Record.Results.Counts.Executed -and $validation.Record.Results.Counts.Skipped -eq 0 -and $sameCases
    $summary = [pscustomobject][ordered]@{
        Schema = 'label-parent-red-verification-v1'
        CheckedUtc = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
        SpecificationComparison = $specificationComparison
        ValidationPath = $validation.Path
        PriorValidation = "$runDirectory/evidence/label-red-r2.json"
        SameTestIdentitiesAndOutcomes = $sameCases
        TestDifferences = @($testComparison.Differences)
        Counts = $validation.Record.Results.Counts
        ExpectedRedConfirmed = $expectedRed
        GreenGatePassed = $false
    }
    Save-AgentEvidence -Value $summary -RunDirectory $runDirectory -Name 'label-parent-r2-verification.json'
    $summary | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
    if (-not $expectedRed) { throw 'Focused validation did not match the recorded expected red.' }
}
